open_prerequisites.dependency_audit: OSV querybatch on 2026-10-19 reported no advisories for the 357 unique registry package/version pairs across all three current lockfiles. This is a point-in-time advisory check, not a security or third-party-license guarantee.

qualification_behavior.blob: Real zero/small/64MiB single PUT+HEAD+fullSHA256GET, Range,404,conditional overwrite,80MiB multipart five16MiBparts with paginatedListParts,5MiB abort and scoped orphan discovery/paginatedListV2
qualification_behavior.checkpoint: Disposable sibling-prefix keys; IfNoneMatch create and duplicate412 unchanged; matchingIfMatch update and stale412 unchanged; concurrent identical ETag updates with exactly one SDK success and one actual412; bounded direct GET matches winning sequence/content; independent checkpoint/package positive controls unchanged
qualification_behavior.ownership: Fixed keys only; intent and checkpoint candidate descriptors are durable before mutation; run metadata required; conditional cleanup uses owned HEAD ETag and verifies absence; retained upload IDs must match recorded key; discovery never grants deletion authority
qualification_behavior.wire_boundary: Exact TLS host/bucket/path-style, package vs checkpoint operation identities, fixed correlated run keys, method/query/range/conditional/header allowlists, durable reservation before connector; no bucket policy/ACL/versioning/lifecycle/administrative calls
qualification_behavior.concurrency: Only two identical-size same-target checkpoint CAS permits may coexist. Both are durably reserved before polling either SDK future and neither is cleared until both settle; sequential operations retain single-use permits. Concurrent per-attempt byte fields are explicitly unavailable, with one nonadditive pair aggregate and exact process totals instead of double-counted intervals
qualification_behavior.ambiguous_completion: One real Complete is sent. HTTP wrapper consumes bounded actual response to EOF, validates successful CompleteMultipartUploadResultXML+ETag (HTTP200Error is not success), durably records post-acceptance suppression and returns INJECTEDtimeout before SDK sees acknowledgment. Existing error path reconciles HEAD ownership+size and fullSHA256GET, never resends Complete or parts
qualification_behavior.fault_injection: Local pre-provider transport timeout/429/503 are labelled INJECTED and exercise real SDK classification with retries disabled. Actual provider HTTP evidence and natural errors are separately labelled; no naturally observed timeout/429/5xx pass is fabricated
qualification_behavior.recovery: Counters and candidate/fault state survive cleanup restart. Lost Create without known uploadID, unknown listed IDs, unrecognized candidate bytes, non-null versions, corrupt manifests, or exhausted retained allowance fail closed and preserve evidence; cleanup cannot mint a fresh allowance
